headband.title: Aluminium headband
headband.desc: Single-piece anodised aluminium. Bends 10,000 times without a crease.

cushion.title: Memory-foam cushions
cushion.desc: Vegan leather over slow-rebound foam. Seals sound in, lets heat out.

driver.title: 40 mm Pulse driver
driver.desc: Titanium-coated diaphragm. 4 Hz to 40 kHz with 0.03% distortion.

chip.title: Pulse A1 chip
chip.desc: Eight microphones, 48,000 measurements a second. Noise cancelled before you hear it.

cup.title: Sculpted ear cups
cup.desc: CNC-milled, recoloured by you. Touch controls hidden in plain sight.

noise.title: The world, muted.
noise.body: Eight microphones map the chaos around you and cancel it 48,000 times a second. Traffic, trains, open offices. Gone.

battery.title: 40-hour battery
battery.desc: A full work week on a single charge. Ten minutes plugged in buys you five more hours.
battery.label: playback with ANC on

spatial.title: Spatial audio
spatial.desc: Head-tracked, 360° sound that stays anchored to the screen as you move.
spatial.label: of head-tracked sound

comfort.title: Feather comfort
comfort.desc: Just 248 grams, with pressure spread evenly across the headband. Forget you're wearing them.

materials.title: Honest materials

video.title: Two minutes of nothing.
video.body: We took AURA One to the loudest places we could find, and recorded what you hear instead.

items.name: Mila K.
items.text: The first ANC that doesn't feel like pressure in my skull. I mix in them. That says everything.

items.name: Jonas R.
items.text: Forty hours is real. I charged them once in two weeks and I ride the train every single day.

items.name: Aisha B.
items.text: I bought the coral ones for the colour and stayed for the sound. Spatial audio on films is unreal.

items.name: Tom H.
items.text: Call quality is the best I've used. People stopped asking me to repeat myself.

items.name: Nina P.
items.text: They stay on. 30 km, zero adjustments. And they wipe clean after.

items.name: Leo M.
items.text: Library mode is literal. The lime pair gets me compliments every single day.

cta.title: Hear nothing. Feel everything.
cta.body: AURA One. Four colours. One silence.

hero.title: Built like an instrument.
hero.body: AURA One is twelve components, eight microphones and one chip, tuned together for three years. Here is what's inside.
hero.alt1: AURA One headphones in Electric Violet on a studio background
hero.alt2: Detail of the aluminium headband hinge

driver.title: 40 millimetres of precision.
driver.body: A titanium-coated diaphragm, a neodymium N52 magnet and a copper-clad aluminium voice coil. The result: bass you feel and detail you didn't know existed.

items.a: Yes. Two dedicated voice microphones isolate your voice while the other six keep the noise out, so both you and the other side hear less of the world.
Yes. AURA One supports USB-C lossless audio and ships with a 3.5 mm cable. ANC keeps working in wired mode.
They twist off in two seconds. Replacement cushions in every colorway are available from launch.
AURA One, a hard travel case, USB-C to USB-C cable, 3.5 mm cable, a flight adapter and a sticker sheet, because why not.
Two years worldwide, plus a repair programme for anything that breaks after that.

hero.title: We make quiet, loudly.
hero.body: AURA Audio started in a Belgrade basement with one question: why do the best headphones all look the same?

timeline.title: From a basement to your ears.

items.title: The question
items.text: Two acoustic engineers and a colour-obsessed designer meet at a concert. They can't hear each other, so they talk about that instead.
items.alt: Sketches and prototypes on a workshop table

items.title: Prototype 01
items.text: Forty-two 3D-printed shells later, the first AURA plays music. It weighs 410 grams and the ANC hums. We keep going.

items.title: The Pulse A1 chip
items.text: We stop buying chips and design our own. Eight microphones, 48,000 measurements a second, and finally, real silence.

items.title: Colour gets serious
items.text: We paint 120 finishes, show them to 2,000 people and keep four. Electric Violet wins by a landslide.
items.alt: Colour swatches arranged on a table

items.title: AURA One
items.text: Launch. Four colours, forty hours, one promise: the world, muted.
items.alt: AURA One headphones on a pedestal under stage light

items.title: Silence is a feature
items.text: We measure noise cancellation in real streets, not anechoic chambers. If it doesn't work on the 6 a.m. tram, it doesn't ship.

items.title: Colour is not a trim level
items.text: Every colorway is designed from scratch, down to the stitching. No 'also available in' afterthoughts.

items.title: Repair over replace
items.text: Cushions, batteries and headbands are user-replaceable. We publish the guides. We sell the parts.

items.title: Honest numbers
items.text: Forty hours means forty hours with ANC on, at 50% volume, measured by someone who isn't us.
